rule.name: DefaultTimeZone
rule.message: ZoneId.systemDefault() and TimeZone.getDefault() read the default time zone of the JVM, so the result changes with the TZ or -Duser.timezone of the server. Pass a zone: ZoneId.of("UTC"), a configured zone, or the zone of an injected Clock (clock.getZone()).

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall[ArgumentList/@Size = 0] [@MethodName = 'systemDefault' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.time.ZoneId')] or @MethodName = 'getDefault' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')] or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.ZoneId#systemDefault()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.TimeZone#getDefault()')] | //MethodReference [@MethodName = 'systemDefault' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.time.ZoneId')] or @MethodName = 'getDefault' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone')]] )
